description.en-US: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, volume I (1863): the introduction on the relations of England to Christianity and thirteen sermons preached at the Provincial Councils of Westminster, in Rome, Paris and London, on dogmatic authority, the Council of Trent, divine faith, the Good Shepherd, unity and the Resurrection of the dry bones.
description.pt-BR: Sermões sobre Assuntos Eclesiásticos, volume I (1863): a introdução sobre as relações da Inglaterra com o cristianismo e treze sermões pregados nos Concílios Provinciais de Westminster, em Roma, Paris e Londres, sobre a autoridade dogmática, o Concílio de Trento, a fé divina, o Bom Pastor, a unidade e a ressurreição dos ossos secos.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863)

sources.edition: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects (vol. 1) (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The sermons and the introduction; the contents, the errata and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1863, so the text is public domain.
